name: What is the difference between liquid waterproofing membranes and sheet membranes?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between liquid waterproofing membranes and sheet membranes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Liquid-applied membranes are rolled or brushed on seamlessly, making them adaptable to custom niches, benches, and irregular angles. However, they require careful monitoring of wet-film thickness and full drying time between coats before tile installation can begin. Sheet membranes and pre-formed foam boards provide an immediate, uniform waterproof barrier with zero cure time, allowing tiling to start the same day, though they require precise seam tape overlaps and thinset bonding. Contractors evaluate the shower layout, complexity of built-in features, and overall construction timeline when deciding which waterproofing method fits best.
acceptedAnswer.description: Liquid membranes brush on seamlessly around custom shower shapes but require cure time, while sheet systems provide instant, uniform thickness across flat walls.
